info.name: Narmi Public account balances wires API

params.name: account_uuid
params.description: Optional account UUID used to filter wire transactions to those for the specified account.

params.name: page
params.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

items.docs: List the authenticated user's wire transactions. Accepts `account_uuid` as a query parameter, limiting results to those relevant to the specified account. User must have permission to read account information. All monetary values are represented in minor units, or the smallest unit of the currency with no decimal (e.g., cents). For example, $10.00 is represented as 1000. How can we improve these docs? Share your feedback.

Creates a new wire transaction. A confirmation email may be sent to members of the `from_account` if wire was submitted for processing (prerequisites such as dual approval were not required). All monetary values are represented in minor units, or the smallest unit of the currency with no decimal (e.g., cents). For example, $10.00 is represented as 1000. How can we improve these docs? Share your feedback.

Retrieve details for a specific wire transaction by UUID. All monetary values are represented in minor units, or the smallest unit of the currency with no decimal (e.g., cents). For example, $10.00 is represented as 1000. How can we improve these docs? Share your feedback.
